file_roles.evidence: Moves backingPropertiesChanged and m_backingPropertiesObserver from the base class to QCALayerBackingStore; follows from the .mm change.

Old backingPropertiesChanged discarded content (`m_image = QImage()` / `m_buffers.clear()`); diff removes it for QNSWindowBackingStore and makes QCALayerBackingStore only update the color space of existing buffers.
Only adds a commented-out CursorFlashTime case; unrelated to the fix.
Constructor drops colorSpace argument and adds setColorSpace(); API adaptation needed so buffers can be re-tagged.
Moves IOSurfaceSetValue color-space code into new setColorSpace(); supports the real fix in qcocoabackingstore.mm.

symptom_location.file: QtWidgets backing store flush (not in gold set)

rationale: Commit text says QtWidgets assumes a flush needs no repaint, but the cocoa backing store threw away its content when the display properties changed (mirror/unmirror). The discard logic in qcocoabackingstore.mm is removed, so that file holds the wrong logic. The other files plumb the color-space tagging.
notes: Where the stale content is shown (QtWidgets) is stated only in the commit message.
